placebo_surface_note: K masks an event on the private board P; N_m masks events on a different surface (public board 0) at a different prompt position. 'Same machinery' means the same persistent index-preserving mask code path, not the same surface.
record_text: Not shown to be generic lesion disruption for removal of non-informational messages (placebo N_m). The placebo does not test whether removing other salient content would produce a similar effect.
